name: apiToken
label: API token
help: A Lichess personal access token from [Preferences → API access tokens](https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token). No scopes are required.

name: usernames
label: Usernames
help: Lichess usernames to track as **Lichess Player** objects, e.g. from `lichess.org/@/DrNykterstein` use `DrNykterstein`. Type a username and press Enter to add it as a chip. Any Lichess team these players belong to is also tracked as a **Lichess Team** object.
